<MethodEndpoint
  method={"put"}
  path={"/api/e2e/transfers/{sessionId}"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



The signed-in device encrypts the identity for the ephemeral key shown
by the new device and stores it under the QR's `sessionId`
(16-64 chars of `A-Za-z0-9_-`). Held in memory for 10 minutes, one
put per session. Session-only.
